card.name: Space before a length in cm or mm
card.fires_on: The space or joiner right before a number that gives a size in centimeters or millimeters, in descriptions of plants, animals and objects. It predicts that a metric length unit is coming soon.

modes.label: Space before a size number
modes.description: The blank just before a measurement range such as 8-10cm or 77 and 97 mm.

modes.label: Joiner inside a dimension
modes.description: An x, dash or bracket within a size range or paired dimensions.

card.writes: It promotes nothing clear, but it suppresses mm tokens, so it likely shifts the unit choice away from millimeters toward cm.
card.plain: It fires just before a size number, in text where the length is given in centimeters or similar units.
